TIDY-TOOL(1)                    User Commands                     TIDY-TOOL(1)

NAME
       tidy-tool — Tidies files.

DESCRIPTION
       A tool that tidies files.

       repository   https://github.test/mira/tidy
       install      go install example.test/tidy@latest

       On a machine with no Go
         curl -fsSL https://example.test/tidy.sh | sh

       stack     Lua · Penlight · LPeg
       release   latest · changelog
       licence   MIT

WHY
       Files were untidy.

HOW IT TIDIES
       tidy . reads each file once.

       - Sorts the lines
       - Keeps the blank ones

       tidy . tidying a folder
       <https://example.test/p/tidy-tool/tidying.mp4>

       - source <https://github.test/mira/tidy> — where the code lives
       - manual <https://docs.example.test/tidy> — every flag it takes

                                      *   *   *

FLAGS
       --check reports what it would tidy and changes nothing.

       - flags <https://docs.example.test/tidy/flags> — each flag in full

CONTACT
       mira@example.test

example.test                                                      TIDY-TOOL(1)
